main_text.head: P. RAMI
PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: SERMONE Græco puerum incipere malo (ait Fab. Quintil.) quia Latinus pluribus in víu eft, vel nobis nolentibus se perhibet simul, quia disciplinis quoque Græcis priús instituendus est, unde & noftræ fluxerunt. At nos ὕστερον πρότερον ὁμοιωτικῶς videlicet Latinam Grammaticā suis partibus integram priús edidimus: deinde communibus utriusq; præternissis, succinctè tantùm collegimus Græcæ cum Latina differentiam. Quamobrem dices? Quoniam (inquam) cúm utraq; Latina pariter & Græca peregrina nobis est, & ad cultum ornatumq; domesticæ linguæ referenda: Latinæ tamen usus ad loquēdum & scribendum re-

page.notes: Woodcut initial "A" (decorated) at paragraph start. Greek phrase "ὕστερον πρότερον ὁμοιωτικῶς" is partly illegible in the scan; the Greek is reproduced as best read. Marginal marks at right (short dashes and a small ornament) carry no legible text. The signature mark at the foot reads "a ij" and the catchword "ré" is uncertain.
